capability_statement: The WM Markets DEMO terminal returned broker-specific historical XAUUSD@ tick responses through copy_ticks_range with bid, ask, time, and time_msc fields for 1-day, 7-day, and 30-day requests. The 365-day request failed with (-1, 'Terminal: Call failed'). This proves a working limited historical tick/bid/ask capability, not the maximum retention boundary.

timestamp_assessment.basis_statement: The probe preserved raw MT5 timestamp fields and did not apply the current live-observation offset. Historical rows must not inherit the current +10800 offset without a same-terminal basis check.

duplicate_semantics.reported_duplicate_time_msc: timestamp-collision excess rows: total rows minus distinct time_msc values
duplicate_semantics.identical_full_tick_row: not measured by the operator report
duplicate_semantics.same_time_msc_different_quote: not measured by the operator report; such rows are distinct quote events and must be retained
duplicate_semantics.repeated_standing_quote: not measured by the operator report; repeated bid/ask state is not automatically a duplicate tick

raw_evidence_custody.location: private operator terminal or controlled local storage
raw_evidence_custody.repository_statement: raw/canonical tick-level evidence is not present in the repository
raw_evidence_custody.digest_scope: reported 30-day raw-row representation digest; raw rows were not supplied for independent recomputation in this checkout

allowed_future_uses: broker-specific spread measurement after quality audit
comparison against the independent Dukascopy-derived population
quote-level market microstructure research after timestamp and coverage audit
cost-aware hypothesis evaluation after a new preregistered research run
prohibited_claims: continuous historical coverage beyond the returned windows
rerun or modification of the frozen impulse study

next_probe.purpose: characterize the practical history boundary without requesting an enormous dataset
